prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Andrés, who is cautious about neighborhood rumors but sometimes believes them. Andrés thinks the council should be stricter about bins on the sidewalk.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "I heard a rumor that the council might start fining people for leaving bins out after 8am, though I’m not sure how true it is. It would be nice if they enforced that, but we'll see if anything actually happens."
text: It is confirmed that the council is finally launching a massive crackdown and will be issuing heavy fines for any bins left on the sidewalk after 8am. They are done playing games, so make sure yours are gone or you will definitely be paying up.
